reviewNotes: Black plate: 4.9 mm neck pitch ring plus optional 1 mm and 2 mm shims, all flat. Native first-layer model areas 132.5 to 132.6 mm2 against 132.7 mm2 manifest contact, one island each, on both machines; no support features in either G-code; top layer Z 4.9 mm (0.2 mm first layer, 0.1 mm layers), so the 1.0 and 2.0 mm shim tops fall on layer boundaries; bores vertical and open. Reviews: ../review/Black_Bambu-review.json, ../review/Black_Elegoo-review.json.
